neighbours.label: The English word 'Mexican' (adjective or noun, any topic: food, people, government, animals), not 'Mexico', 'Mexicans', other-language forms (mexicana) or other nationality words such as Canadian, Indian or Japanese; Turkish and Spanish fire weakly, and brand names inside lists of companies (Marriott, Vivendi) also fire and are not tested here.
